title: Power Apps: speech as an input source for form fill assistance in model-driven apps
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing requirements and documented general form fill controls are supported. Speech-specific governance and processing details are appropriately left unconfirmed; the summary should describe speech input as planned rather than already available.

claims.claim: Power Apps form fill assistance in model-driven apps accepts speech as an input source.
claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use speech as a source, providing users a more natural way to fill forms.
claims.fix: Replace the summary's first sentence with: 'Microsoft plans to let users in model-driven apps record speech with a microphone icon and use the transcript as a source for form fields.' The roadmap status remains In development.

claims.claim: Storage and retention of the speech transcript are not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "speech" "transcript" "retention". Opened Learn's form-filling-assistance and faq-from-filling-assistance; read Speech to text privacy search excerpts. No passage identifies transcript retention for this feature.

claims.claim: The speech processing architecture is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps form fill assistance speech microphone transcript retention processing permissions speech meter licensing controls; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-apps "speech" "form fill". Opened form-filling-assistance and its responsible AI FAQ; neither describes speech processing.

claims.claim: Fields with column security are not supported for current form fill suggestions.
claims.quote: Fields that have column security aren't currently supported.

claims.claim: Microphone permission requirements for this speech feature are not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "speech" "microphone" "permissions"; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-apps "speech" "form fill". Opened form-filling-assistance and its FAQ. Results about Windows speech, Dragon and canvas controls do not establish this feature's requirements.

claims.claim: The documented licensing model for form fill assistance is per-user.
claims.quote: The form fill assistance requires specific user licenses based on the product.

claims.quote: Power Apps model-driven app: The user must have a Power Apps premium license.

claims.claim: Form fill assistance in Dynamics 365 model-driven apps requires a Dynamics 365 enterprise or premium license.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 model-driven app: The user must have a Dynamics 365 enterprise or premium license as outlined in Dynamics 365 License Guide.

claims.claim: The feature is hidden for a user without the required license.
claims.quote: If the user doesn't have the license, the feature is hidden.

claims.claim: License enforcement gradually rolls out following the feature's general availability.
claims.quote: This license enforcement gradually rolls out following the feature's general availability.

claims.claim: No additional speech-specific meter or charge is published.

claims.claim: Learn marks the underlying form fill assistance feature as production ready preview in Power Apps.
claims.quote: This feature is in production ready preview in Power Apps.

claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center documents Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry as the primary form fill assistance control.
claims.quote: The primary admin control for form fill assistance is moving to the Power Platform admin center under Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry.

claims.claim: An API for the environment-level Data entry control is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Data entry Form fill assistance environment admin control API PowerShell SaveSettingValue; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-platform "Data entry" "API". Opened form-filling-assistance, copilot-hub and client API reference; none maps an API to this control.

claims.claim: The move of the primary form fill assistance control is gradually rolling out.
claims.quote: Learn more in Copilot hub. This change is gradually rolling out.

claims.claim: Selecting a Copilot setting opens a panel where the administrator selects an environment and Edit setting.
claims.quote: When you select a setting, a panel opens where you can select your environment or group, select Edit setting, and configure the control.

claims.claim: The app's Form fill assist toolbar control is available in app designer > Settings > Features.
claims.quote: When you select Settings from the command bar, select Features to enable or disable model-driven app features for the app. Form fill assist toolbar.

claims.claim: App designer setting changes require saving and publishing the app.
claims.quote: You must select Publish to activate an app settings change. Save and Publish the app.

claims.quote: Smart paste (FormPredictSmartPasteEnabled) and form fill assist toolbar (FormFileUploadEnabled) app settings

claims.claim: A separate speech-specific switch is not yet documented on either the admin UI or API surface.

Opened form-filling-assistance, app-properties, copilot-hub and client API reference.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not yet confirmed which existing form fill controls, including the column property, govern the speech source.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill" "speech" "control"; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-apps "speech" "form fill". Opened form-filling-assistance, app-properties, settings-features and copilot-hub. These document general controls but do not describe their applicability to speech.

claims.claim: The legacy environment feature settings are listed in the feature settings reference and are being removed from their former location.
claims.quote: Admin controls for the AI form fill assistance feature are changing. The primary admin control moves to Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry. The following settings are removed from the Environment > Settings > Features page.
